issues.span: 捨棄道步入歧路此乃魔事
issues.evidence: Tibetan ལམ་བོར་ལམ་གོལ་འགྲོ་བ། འདི་ནི་བདུད་ཀྱི་ལས། has two clauses (abandoning the path and going astray; 'this is the work of Mara'). The Chinese runs them together with no punctuation, unlike the other three lines, which makes the line harder to parse. The meaning is intact.
issues.fix: 捨棄道而步入歧路，此乃魔事。
